title: session
description: Schema for Antigravity session transcripts, as the harness writes them at ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<session>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl and transcript_full.jsonl and as corpus-yoga agent capture stashes them, converted to a JSON array (one step per line becomes one element). The family describes the step record as observed on home-room and reading-room on 2026-09-15 (Antigravity 2.13.0); the session's step database (conversation.db, protobuf) and its summaries row (summary.json) are not described here. Every definition ends with its layer, drawn from layer.csv beside this file: the record's own layers, named as a first reading, beside MCP's.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: An ordered sequence of steps produced by one Antigravity session, converted from transcript.jsonl (one step per line) to a JSON array. The same family describes transcript_full.jsonl beside it: the same steps with no field truncated and no truncated_fields entry. Observed on home-room (session 5bb62af7, 88 steps, 2026-09-14) and reading-room (session a821b300, 2069 steps, 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-15). Layer: step.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One step of the session: an envelope of five fields present on every observed step (step_index, source, type, status, created_at), and beside it the fields the step's type carries - a user input its content; a planner response any of content, thinking and tool_calls; a generic, system message or checkpoint step its content - plus, in the plain transcript only, the names of the fields the harness truncated. Layer: step.

step_index.description: The step's position, an integer from 0. Ascending on home-room's session and not on reading-room's, whose 2069 steps repeat indices where the harness resumed the session, so the array order is the record's order and the index a label. Layer: step.

content.description: The step's text: a user input's request wrapped in the harness's tags (USER_REQUEST, ADDITIONAL_METADATA), a model's prose, a tool's output on a generic step, a system message, or a checkpoint summary. Truncated in the plain transcript where truncated_fields names it. Layer: content.

thinking.description: The model's thinking on a planner response, where the harness recorded it (one step of 88 on home-room, 295 of 2069 on reading-room). Layer: content.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls a planner response made, in order. Layer: tools.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: Who wrote the step. Observed values: USER_EXPLICIT (the person's input), MODEL (the model's planner responses and the generic steps that carry tool output), SYSTEM (system messages and checkpoints, reading-room only). Likely an open set. Layer: actor.

StepType.title: StepType
StepType.description: What kind of step. Observed values: USER_INPUT (source USER_EXPLICIT), PLANNER_RESPONSE (the model's turn: prose, thinking, tool calls), GENERIC (a tool's output, source MODEL), SYSTEM_MESSAGE and CHECKPOINT (source SYSTEM, reading-room only). Likely an open set. Layer: actor.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: The step's state when the transcript was written. Observed values: DONE, and RUNNING on 30 of reading-room's steps, captured while the session was live. Likely an open set. Layer: step.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: When the step was created: an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp to the second, no fraction. Pattern: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. Example: "2026-09-14T11:23:39Z". Layer: step.

ToolCall.title: ToolCall
ToolCall.description: One tool call: the tool's name and its arguments. Names observed across both rooms: list_dir, view_file, run_command, grep_search, write_to_file, replace_file_content, manage_task, schedule, find_by_name and others; the set is the harness's. Layer: tools.

name.description: The tool's name as the harness registers it. Layer: tools.

args.description: The arguments, an object whose keys are the tool's own; truncated in the plain transcript where truncated_fields names tool_calls. Layer: tools.

TruncatedFields.title: TruncatedFields
TruncatedFields.description: The fields of this step the harness truncated in the plain transcript, absent where nothing was; transcript_full.jsonl carries them whole and never has this entry. Observed values: content, tool_calls, thinking. Layer: truncation.

items.description: A field name of Step. The set is exhaustive: the three fields a step carries beyond its envelope are the three the harness can truncate; a fourth would mint a new version. Layer: truncation.
